name: WorldCereal Harmonized Global In-Situ Crop Reference Dataset
description: WorldCereal Harmonized Reference Data is the global, multi-source reference ground-truth benchmark developed under the ESA WorldCereal project by an international consortium including VITO, IIASA, and Wageningen University. Assembling and harmonizing in-situ ground observations from more than 80 independent regional and national data collections across all continents, this open benchmark provides over 400,000 standardized spatial point and polygon records with verified labels for crop extent, crop type (maize, cereals), and irrigation status to train and benchmark global agricultural mapping models.
